algebraic_construction.parameter: alpha=tan(pi/17), the unique root in (9/50,19/100) of the listed degree-16 minimal polynomial
algebraic_construction.primary_source_mapping: Green-Tao §2 Theorem 2.5 maps the acnodal cubic Y^2 Z=X^2(X-Z) by t=cot(pi*x) to [t^2+1:t(t^2+1):1]. At x=k/17, scale to [sin(theta):cos(theta):sin(theta)^3], then swap the last two homogeneous coordinates to obtain the task's affine points. No cos(k*pi/17) vanishes for k=0,...,16.
algebraic_construction.line_identity: For t_i=tan(theta_i), the collinearity determinant is (t1-t2)(t1-t3)(t2-t3)(t1*t2*t3-t1-t2-t3)/prod(1+t_i^2). Thus a distinct triple is collinear exactly when its three angles sum to 0 modulo pi.
algebraic_construction.exact_count: There are 40 unordered distinct triples k1<k2<k3 in 0..16 with k1+k2+k3=0 mod 17. The points lie on an irreducible cubic with no line component, so no line contains four of them.
